46. Descending Elements Below N

Problem Statement:
Given a number N and an array of N elements, print all elements lesser than N in descending order. If no element found print -1.
input_spec: The input consists of a number N, and an array of N elements. N is between 1 and 10000 (inclusive).
output_spec: Print all elements from the array that are lesser than N, in descending order. If no such elements are found, print -1.
